report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
report.evidence: Inter IKEA Systems B.V. is responsible for the placement of cookies and the processing of your personal information collected through cookies placed on these websites.
report.reason: The policy clearly identifies the controller and its responsibilities.

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.evidence: Data Protection Officer, Inter IKEA Holding B.V., Olof Palmestraat 1, 2616 LN Delft, Nederland.
report.reason: The policy provides specific contact details for the DPO.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: We may collect and use records and copies of your correspondence.
report.reason: The policy explicitly states the types of personal data collected.

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: We use cookies. These are small text files that are stored on your computer, phone or tablet.
report.reason: The policy mentions cookies as a means of data collection but lacks detail on other methods.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: We use your personal data to complete your purchase, provide services, communicate with you about appointments and to improve our store and our services.
report.reason: The policy clearly states the purposes for collecting and processing personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: We base our processing of this data on the legal ground of legitimate interest
report.reason: The policy clearly states the legal basis for processing personal data.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.evidence: We ask for your name, e-mail address and phone number
report.reason: The policy mentions some personal data collected but does not specify which are mandatory or optional.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.evidence: If you do not accept analytical cookies it may adversely affect your experience of the website
report.reason: The policy mentions consequences of not providing data in the context of cookies but lacks broader implications.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: Sometimes we share your details with service providers who carry out the work for us
report.reason: The policy specifies parties with whom personal data is shared.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.evidence: These third parties may be in the Netherlands as well as within other countries in the European Economic Area (EEA)
report.reason: The policy mentions potential transfers outside the EEA but lacks specifics about the Kingdom.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.evidence: We will keep your personal information for no longer than necessary for the purpose for which we process your data.
report.reason: The policy clearly states how long personal data is kept.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.evidence: We take both technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information against destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure or access.
report.reason: The policy mentions storage and protection but does not specify destruction methods.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: You have different privacy rights: Right of access. You can ask us whether we process your personal information and if so receive a copy of such data.
report.reason: The policy clearly outlines the data subject's rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.evidence: If you would like to exercise your rights or learn more, feel free to contact us.
report.reason: The policy provides information on how to exercise rights.

report.evidence: You can withdraw your consent at any time by logging into your account on www.ikea.com/nl and updating your preferences.
report.reason: The policy clearly states how to withdraw consent.

report.requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: We take both technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information against destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure or access
report.reason: The policy clearly states the measures taken to protect personal data.

report.requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.reason: The policy does not mention anything about decisions made solely by automated processing.
